scope: Professional scraping infrastructure for Mercado Livre Brazil prelisting price discovery

decisive_source_rule.finding: Mercado Livre Developer Program terms prohibit robots, harvesters, spiders and scraping of the Site to obtain information outside the Program.
decisive_source_rule.effect: A scraping provider does not make the collection professionally authorized; written source authorization remains required.

confirmed: Structured product ID, URL, title, current and original price
API, webhook, batch and scheduled delivery
providers.matching: EAN can be used as a search input, but exact EAN matching is not a documented native contract and remains our responsibility.
providers.contract: Standard license is internal-use and does not grant sublicensing or OEM redistribution.

confirmed: Server-to-server scraper API, JavaScript rendering, batch and scheduler
providers.matching: Requires Mercado Livre search/PDP requests and our identity gate; no dedicated GTIN contract proved.
providers.contract: Target-site terms remain the customer's responsibility; resale requires an authorized statement of work.

confirmed: Product and product-list schemas can include URL, price, GTIN and MPN
providers.matching: No Mercado Livre-specific extractor was proved.
providers.contract: Standard terms focus on internal intelligence, restrict third-party processing and allow suspension for source-term violations.

confirmed: Community Mercado Livre actors accept keyword searches
Some actors return price, URL and seller
providers.matching: EAN can be a keyword but precision is not guaranteed.
providers.contract: Community actor developers may access inputs/outputs and users retain responsibility for rights and source compliance.

production_gate: Written Mercado Livre authorization or verifiable provider authorization for automated collection
Provider statement of work allowing server-to-server use, cache, normalization, multi-tenant display and cross-tenant reuse
DPA, at least 99.9 percent SLA, parser change policy and responsibility for source/data licensing
Five-product canary with the known collision EAN, zero false accepts and repeatability across two runs
Fifty-product validation only after the legal and five-product gates pass
